```{r}
SGStock <- read_csv("data/SGStock.csv")
```

```{r}
daily_prices <- SGStock %>%
  select(Symbol) %>%
  tq_get(get = "stock.prices",
         from = "2025-01-01",
         to = Sys.Date())

daily_prices <- daily_prices %>%
  left_join(SGStock)
  
```
